subject: general
question: What will be an equivalent discount of two successive discounts of 40% and 30% for an article?
solution:
Given: 

Two successive discounts of 40% and 30% 

Formula Used:

Single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of a % and b %

= (a + b - (a space times space b)/(100) ) %

Calculation:

Here, a = 40 % , and b = 30 %

So the single discount Nirmala gets, (40 + 30 - (40 space times space 30)/(100)) %

⇒ (70 - 12) %

⇒ 58 %

**The single discount is 58%**
